title: AI-Enhanced Organoid Platform for Pandemic Preparedness and Personalized Medicine
summary: The organoid platform reports early partner testing and claims that AI screening can reduce discovery timelines by 50%; treatment benefits remain intended.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The submission describes biotech and hospital-laboratory testing in Hong Kong and Shanghai, with reported latency below 80 milliseconds and satisfaction above 4.7 out of 5. It also claims 50% faster virtual drug screening, without a project-specific comparison. Pandemic response and personalized treatment are intended downstream benefits.
purpose: Accelerate drug research and analysis for organoid-based medicine.
system: AI-Enhanced Organoid Platform for Pandemic Preparedness and Personalized Medicine

ratings.reason: The submission claims that AI virtual screening reduces discovery timelines by 50%; the stated magnitude is time saving, while a project-specific comparison is not supplied.
Personalized treatment is an intended downstream benefit, without a patient health result in the source.
Pandemic preparedness and equitable access remain intended outcomes.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 26: AI-Enhanced Organoid Platform for Pandemic Preparedness and Personalized Medicine

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: An organoid AI platform targets faster drug research

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
